'''2009 Bespin Regionals Nick Swedal DS Fondor''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Nick Swedal]] at [[2009 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Fondor|SE-D-fondor.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Deck one
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
